excerpt.zh: 初步报告显示这星球上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。研究员提议组织进一步在轨研究以更加深入了解这种神秘生物。
excerpt.en: Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering this planet is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before. Researchers propose an extended orbital study be organized in order to learn more about this mysterious being.

texts.zh: 初步报告显示这星球上的海洋从某种程度上来说居然是活的，其中包含着一种我们从来都没见过的外星实体。研究员提议组织进一步在轨研究以更加深入了解这种神秘生物。
texts.en: Preliminary reports suggest the ocean covering this planet is somehow alive, comprising an alien entity unlike any we've encountered before. Researchers propose an extended orbital study be organized in order to learn more about this mysterious being.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上实施殖民地决议之后，一支研究团队将部署在轨道上，从安全的距离研究奇特的海洋。

由于无法进一步研究[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]协助发现的神秘物体，科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]表示十分失望。但本着任务比个人兴趣更重要的原则，[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]愿意接受[living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer]目前的任务。
texts.en:
With the enactment of the Colony Decision on [From.GetName], a research team will be placed in orbit to study the strange sea presence at a safe distance.

Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] has expressed some regret at being unable to further study the mysterious entity [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] helped discover, but [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetIsAre] willing to accept [living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer] current assignment as taking precedence over personal interests.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]上实施殖民地决议之后，一支研究团队将部署在轨道上，从安全的距离研究奇特的海洋。

轨道上的研究团队想马上开始进行研究，如果有任何突破进展，他们会告知我们。
texts.en:
With the enactment of the Colony Decision on [From.GetName], a research team will be placed in orbit to study the strange sea presence at a safe distance.

The orbital team is eager to begin their study, and will be sure to keep us apprised of any breakthroughs.

label.zh: 有什么消息及时通知我们。

texts.zh:
我们从科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]那里收到了异常的通讯联络。[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]要求立即将自己调往[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的研究站。[living_planet_scientist.GetName]声称[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]日夜不停地思考着星球上的神秘海洋存在，并且[living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe]承认这些思绪并非都属于[living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer]自己。

这一请求可谓是学术与疯癫各参半，一边说明这海中生物有能力在神经上影响与其接触的有机生物，一边却宣称这正是它用逝去的爱人的声音与[living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]沟通的原因。

我们无法确定[living_planet_scientist.GetName]能否继续履行职责。但另一方面，如果允许[living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]与轨道科研团队共事，或许可以为我们提供深入了解[living_planet_tar.GetName]星球上的神秘存在的机会。
texts.en:
We are receiving an unusual communique from Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. Apparently, [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetIsAre] requesting immediate transfer to the orbital research team on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. [living_planet_scientist.GetName] claims [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] [living_planet_scientist.GetHasHave] been hounded night and day by thoughts of the mysterious sea presence on the planet - thoughts, [living_planet_scientist.GetSheHe] attest[living_planet_scientist.GetSXX], that are only partly [living_planet_scientist.GetHisHer] own.

The request wavers on the precipice between academic and rambling, suggesting the sea presence possesses the ability to imprint neurologically on those it comes into contact with - only to allege that this is why it speaks to [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer] in the voice of lost loved ones.

It is unclear if [living_planet_scientist.GetName] is unfit for further duty. On the other hand, allowing [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer] to cohabitate with the research team may give them the opportunity for deeper insights into the entity on [living_planet_tar.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们收到了来自科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]的一份不同寻常的公报，似乎想要立即被调往位于[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的科研空间站。[living_planet_scientist.GetName]宣称其整日整夜都在想着那颗星球上的神秘海中生物，不过承认这些思绪并非都属于自己。

这一请求可谓是学术与疯癫各参半，一边说明这海中生物有能力在神经上影响与其接触的有机生物，一边却宣称这正是它用逝去的爱人的声音与其沟通的原因。

我们无法确定[living_planet_scientist.GetName]能否继续履行职责。但另一方面，允许其与轨道科研队伍共事，或许可以为我们提供深入了解[living_planet_tar.GetName]星球上的神秘存在的机会。
texts.en:
We are receiving an unusual communique from Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. Apparently, they are requesting immediate transfer to the orbital research team on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. [living_planet_scientist.GetName] claims they have been hounded night and day by thoughts of the mysterious sea presence on the planet - thoughts, they attest, are only partly their own.

The request wavers on the precipice between academic and rambling, suggesting the sea presence possesses the ability to imprint neurologically on organic beings it comes into contact with - only to allege that this is why it speaks to them in the voice of lost loved ones.

It is unclear if [living_planet_scientist.GetName] is unfit for further duty. On the other hand, allowing them to cohabitate with the research team may create the opportunity for deeper insights into the entity on [living_planet_tar.GetName].

texts.zh:
位于[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道研究站的研究团队最近在星球神秘海洋的研究上取得重大突破。研究专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]对团队的贡献尤其突出。研究人员认为星球上的海洋是某种灵能体：虽然此海洋没有身体，但却有复杂的相干量子波结构，从而构成了一个前所未见的巨型神经网络。

[living_planet_scientist.GetName]的研究让我们发现了一个惊人的灵能理论，并加深了我们对量子态与意识之间交互的理解。至于[living_planet_scientist.GetName][living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]本人嘛：我们的这位前科学专员会继续留在轨道研究站上观测星球上的神秘海洋。
texts.en:
Our research crew in orbit of [living_planet_tar.GetName] has made a series of fascinating breakthroughs regarding the planet's strange sea of consciousness. With Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName] acting as an invaluable asset to the team, the crew has described the planetary sea as a psionic entity. Its seemingly incorporeal state in fact belies a complex and coherent quantum wave structure, approximating a massive neural network unlike any other on record.

[living_planet_scientist.GetName]'s research has led to incredible insights into psionic theory, and deepened our understanding of the interaction of quantum states and consciousness. As for [living_planet_scientist.GetName] [living_planet_scientist.GetHimHer]self: our former Science Officer will remain on the orbital facility for as long as we maintain it, observing the entity from afar.

texts.zh:
我是科研专——不，是前科学专员[living_planet_scientist.GetName]。我无法理解上面的人做出的让我深陷如此窘境的愚蠢决定，既然我的要求被你们无视，那么我只有一个选择了。

[living_planet_tar.GetName]上面有个智能意识体，不对，准确的说是，[living_planet_tar.GetName]本身就是那个智能意识体。你们不会明白的，因为你们没有切身体会过，不过你们很快就会体会到了。
texts.en:
This is Science Offi - former Science Officer [living_planet_scientist.GetName]. I cannot pretend to understand the narrow-minded decision making that has led me here, but as my requests have fallen upon deaf ears, there is only one course of action left to me.

There is a consciousness on [living_planet_tar.GetName]. No, not on it. [living_planet_tar.GetName] is the consciousness. You won't understand. How could you? You haven't felt it. Not yet.

label.en: What is the meaning of this?

在[living_planet_tar.GetName]轨道上的研究团队对星球上神秘海洋的研究已经取得重大进展，研究人员认为星球上的海洋是某种灵能体：虽然此海洋没有身体，但却有复杂的相干量子波结构，从而构成了一个前所未见的巨型神经网络。

团队的研究让我们发现了一个惊人的灵能理论，并加深了我们对量子态与意识之间交互的理解。这个研究所深入的科研领域远远超出了[Root.GetName]上的水平。

Our research crew in orbit of [living_planet_tar.GetName] has made a series of fascinating breakthroughs regarding the planet's strange sea of consciousness. The crew has described the planetary sea as a psionic entity: its seemingly incorporeal state in fact belies a complex and coherent quantum wave structure, approximating a massive neural network unlike any other on record.

The crew's research has led to astounding insights into psionic theory, and deepened our understanding of the interaction of quantum states and consciousness. We now have access to a field of scientific discovery hitherto unimagined in the [Root.GetName].

# 研究智慧海洋 / Study The Living Sea

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:6324-6380` · `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1512,1933,4188` · `common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:1605`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “海洋活着”故事的补发机制：空间站被毁(on_starbase_destroyed)时，仅当星系带living_planet_system星旗，隐藏事件distar.1999才触发distar.199；建造前哨/空间站转让时也直接触发199。  
  Re-enable mechanism of the Haunting Sea story: when a starbase is destroyed (on_starbase_destroyed) hidden distar.1999 fires distar.199 if the system has the living_planet_system flag; building an outpost / transferring a starbase triggers 199 directly.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 199（关卡）：若该国持有事件链living_planet_chain且未在进行STUDY_LIVING_SEA，则启用项目STUDY_LIVING_SEA并中止他国的同项目（改为兴趣点）。项目完成→distar.191→192（180±30天）→194（360±60天）或195（90±10天）→196；191也在3600天后触发193。  
  199 (gatekeeper): if the country holds the living_planet_chain and is not already running STUDY_LIVING_SEA it enables the project and aborts rivals' copies (turning them into a point of interest). On completion → distar.191 → 192 (180+/-30 days) → 194 (360+/-60) or 195 (90+/-10) → 196; 191 also fires 193 after 3600 days.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 192的a/b互斥（继续研究 / 官员叛变）。  
  Options a/b of 192 are exclusive (continue / officer defects).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
